newsitem.title: UK: Upland cottons firmer in post-holiday Europe.
newsitem.headline: Upland cottons firmer in post-holiday Europe.

text.p: Prices for upland cottons were quoted at firm rates in Europe but industry sources said bullish sentiment was tempered by Friday's sharp fall in New York futures.

There were few firm trades reported but as selected markets return to normal after the holidays, buying interest took up where it left off at the end of 1996 with quality cottons for nearby shipment the focus of attention.
Prices for middling grade 1-3/32 were quoted 0.50 to 1.25 cents a lb lower, with U.S. origins experiencing the biggest drop.
